cancellationShort: Life happens, we get it. Cancel 24+ hours ahead and we'll issue store credit for the full amount paid, good for 30 days on any public session.
cancellationDetails: Cancelling and rescheduling count as the same thing. One reschedule is allowed per reservation; a second cancellation forfeits the credit.
Cancellations within 24 hours and no-shows aren't eligible for credit or rescheduling. This includes reservations made less than 24 hours before the session.
Custom events, including Paint Your Pet, aren't eligible for refunds, credit, or rescheduling.
If Bloom has to cancel or consolidate a session because of low sign-ups or another unforeseen reason, we'll email everyone signed up by 9 PM the night before whenever possible.
Reservation cost doesn't include food or drink, so kitchen closures or unavailable menu items aren't eligible for refunds or credit.
shopReturns: Ready-made artwork and studio shop purchases are final sale and non-refundable.
payment: Public workshops are paid in full when booking. Active Bloom Club members can choose to use an available workshop credit instead of going through payment.
promotions: Eligible discount codes and active membership discounts are applied in the cart. Discounts do not stack; the best eligible discount is used.
taxNote: Massachusetts sales tax is calculated on taxable ready-made artwork in the shop. Workshop prices are shown as listed at checkout.
